name: 形象工坊 OpenElf
description: Create AI characters from a one-line idea: combine parts, generate previews, save a character card and produce final artwork.
description_zh: 一句话描述想要的 AI 形象，组合配件生成预览，保存角色卡并产出正式立绘，支持风格选择与形象管理。
description_en: Describe the AI character you want, combine parts, generate previews, save a character card and produce final artwork, with style selection and character management.
examples_zh: 帮我设计一只赛博朋克风的 AI 形象，先给几版预览
把这张角色卡生成正式立绘并保存
列出我保存过的所有角色卡
examples_en: Design a cyberpunk AI character and show me a few previews
Generate the final artwork for this character card and save it
List all the character cards I have saved
